tuning_calibration: Normalize stable synthesized fundamental (1.1..2.0s) to A4=440 temperament; source/native metrics remain separate; independently verify integer output afterward
body_assignment: Short nonharmonic resonances below 700Hz, >0.08*f0 away from nearest harmonic; equivalent sound model, not unique physical identification
parameter_format: 130 bits: valid[129], body_fixed_pitch[128], step[127:96], phase[95:64], peak[63:48], decay[47:24], onset_decay[23:0]
quiet_retirement: after 0.5s, sum of nonnegative modal envelopes <32768 in unsigned Q16 PCM amplitude; clear all envelopes
